general_information.Description: This course addresses several of the major ethical and policy issues that are changing the way engineers think about information and communication technologies This course will cover three broad categories Cybersafety, Cyberethics and Cybersecurity (C3) and how they are interrelated, providing the opportunity for vigorous discussion and exploration of the complex issues involved in C3 technology policy. Through a variety of case studies and group work, detailing IT issues, recent case law, position papers, original articles and resources, as well as scenarios for discussion, student will give consideration to responses that can be applied in their own organization.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

assessments.Question Type: A group of 4-5 students will be assigned a specific a case study related to Cyber Law or Ethics in IT to analyse and present in class.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on topics of studied units
assessments.Note: Assessment will be based on both the presentation and the ability to handle and manage class discussion.

Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.
